config.name: Lootbox numbers
config.label: Configure
config.hint: Every weight, sell ratio, target and box price the lootbox uses. Saving updates the roll tables.

chatVisibility.name: Chat card visibility
chatVisibility.hint: Who sees the lootbox chat card by default. Private whispers it to the GMs and the players who own the buyer; with no buyer it goes to the GMs only. The Lootbox window can change it per box, and a GM can reveal a card later from its chat context menu.

config.title: Lootbox Numbers
config.intro: Weights are relative: a table rolls a die the size of their sum, so each weight is that many faces. Saving rewrites the six structural roll tables and reweights the pool tables in place. Box prices do not change by themselves: use “Fit prices to targets” after changing weights, sell ratios or targets.
config.extraKindHint: Rolled for every item after the first; the first item is always permanent.
config.offsetHint: Item level relative to the box level, per rarity (weight 0 = never).
config.sellRatio: Sell ratio (share of the price when sold)
config.typesHint: A pool table picks an item type by these weights among the types it holds, then an item of that type, so a slot with many compendium entries is no more likely than one with few. Chance assumes every type is present; where a type has no items at some level and rarity, the others share its part. Weight 0 removes a type from the pools; raising it from 0 again takes a Rebuild.
config.untypedPools: These pool tables were built before item type weights existed, so the weights below are not applied yet and the odds use the tables as they are. Rebuild the tables (Lootbox window) to apply them.
config.targetsHint: Each box level should land inside these ranges; off-target levels show in red below.
config.priceFactorHint: Consumables priced above this multiple of the standard price for their level are left out (the Greenbane entries). Takes effect when the tables are rebuilt.
config.noPool: Build the lootbox tables to see the odds.
config.fixProblems: Fix the problems below to see the odds.
config.allOnTarget: Every box level meets the target odds.
config.offTarget: {count} box level(s) miss the target odds.
config.fitted: Prices fitted. Check the odds and save.
config.savedSynced: Lootbox numbers saved and the roll tables updated.
config.poolsUntyped: Item type weights saved, but the pool tables predate them. Rebuild the lootbox tables to apply them.
config.restoreTypes: Rebuild the lootbox tables to bring back items of: {types}.
config.poolTablesRemoved: {count} pool table(s) were deleted because every item in them now has type weight 0.
